newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen nabs "pregnant" mobile phone smuggler.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen nabs "pregnant" mobile phone smuggler.

text.p: China customs officials have caught a woman trying to smuggle 49 mobile phones into the country hidden in a bag designed to make her look pregnant, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said on Thursday.
The woman was carrying under her overcoat mobile phones and accessories worth up to 500,000 yuan ($60,200) from Hong Kong to Shenzhen, the newspaper said.
Customs officers caught the suspect, surnamed Ling, as she walked nervously towards them on March 4, it said.
Official statistics show China had 6.2 million registered mobile phone users at the end of last October and industry officials estimate the number will reach 20 million by the year 2000.
